title: Through the Prism of Culture: Evaluating LLMs’ Understanding of Indian Subcultures and Traditions
reasoning: The paper includes multiple case studies specifically designed to evaluate LLMs' understanding of religious traditions, rituals, and institutions, such as Monotheistic Hindu communities (Lingayats), the concepts of purity and pollution in Hinduism, and traditional religious rituals like the Bhekuli Biyah (Frog Marriages).
